yeast.null_method: permuted-validated-flag (placeholder; coordinate catalogue not in repo)
yeast.note: Without a coordinate-level catalogue file, we permute the validated flag across leads. This trivially gives null_mean = obs (by construction). A coordinate-level catalogue would let us compute the random-position null. Treat the per-species rate as descriptive, not as evidence of fine-mapping accuracy beyond chance.
yeast.random_position_estimate: see notes (coordinate catalogue not in repo)
